tests.name: native_word_binary_title_edits_preserve_unrelated_streams_and_invert
assertions: Thirteen native body title edits retain source bytes and all unrelated CFB stream payloads, preserve paragraph/table counts, keep attached AutoText readable and invert to the entire original CFB file.
tests.scope_limit: Only WordDocument/table streams may change; passive macro/font/object preservation is not execution or full semantic coverage.

tests.name: native_word_binary_plain_body_create_move_and_delete_round_trip
assertions: Unicode paragraph creation, movement and deletion on a native body; exact expected paragraph sequence and exact inverse/source bytes.
tests.scope_limit: Plain ordinary body only; no table restructuring or layout rendering.

tests.name: native_word_binary_master_directory_and_extensionless_child_stay_inert
assertions: Exact native WKB start/outline/file-name key and FNIF absolute/relative path metadata; parent does not load child, and the extensionless child opens independently with exact body text.
tests.scope_limit: Inert references only; no external resolution or master assembly.

tests.name: native_word_binary_password_contract_preserves_ciphertext_and_reservation
assertions: Absent/wrong/correct passwords, exact five paragraphs and write-reservation string; no-op output is original ciphertext; ordinary edit returns typed Encrypted refusal.
tests.scope_limit: Public disposable password, native CryptoAPI RC4 profile; no encrypted body editing or rekey support claimed.

tests.name: native_word_binary_form_data_retains_defaults_and_undefined_stored_states
assertions: Three typed FFData records: text name/default/cache/length/help, checkbox default true versus undefined state, dropdown two entries/default versus undefined selection; entry/exit macro names remain inert.
tests.scope_limit: Stored forms only; no UI state change, calculation or macro execution.

tests.name: native_word_binary_review_comments_retain_reply_parent_and_local_timestamps
assertions: Two exact comment bodies/authors with trailing CR, root/reply depth and parent index, local DTTM timestamps and absent ink flag.
tests.scope_limit: Read-only legacy comment metadata; no reactions or collaboration service behavior.

tests.name: native_word_move_accept_and_reject_preserve_the_source_and_are_reversible
assertions: Both native move acceptance and rejection produce exact six-paragraph bodies, remove all revision marks and invert to original source bytes.
tests.scope_limit: Single fixture move pair, without fields/comments overlapping the moved ranges.

tests.name: native_word_glossary_survives_deferred_character_formatting
assertions: Bold edit on the main title preserves attached glossary text/metadata, paragraph alignment and run text/bold/size; both FIBs retain shared CHPX/PAPX pointers and size.
tests.scope_limit: Main-story character edit only, not arbitrary attached glossary mutation.

tests.name: changed_publication_refuses_preexisting_broken_glossary_header_coupling
assertions: In-memory malformed derivatives of the native DOT with mismatched shared CHPX pointers or cbMac are refused on a title edit; source bytes remain intact.
tests.scope_limit: Negative derivatives only; the on-disk native fixture stays unchanged.

tests.name: native_word_binary_template_queries_and_atomic_edits_preserve_autotext
assertions: Native template paragraph query paths and two atomic text changes on Auto/Eager routes; reopen retains exact AutoText content and identity; inverse restores the original CFB bytes.
tests.scope_limit: Ordinary main-body edits only; no native Word reopen or glossary-content editing.

tests.name: native_excel_hyperlink_retains_target_tooltip_and_revision_identity
assertions: Native A10 hyperlink has exact inert target, tooltip and 2014 revision GUID.
tests.scope_limit: Read-only hyperlink identity; no target resolution or collaboration service.

tests.name: native_excel_hyperlink_edit_keeps_revision_uid_and_other_parts
assertions: Tooltip replacement preserves native revision GUID, target and every unrelated member; reopen and inverse retain source state.
tests.scope_limit: Existing worksheet hyperlink only; no new-sheet links or external actions.

tests.name: native_excel_variants_keep_catalog_kinds_and_every_package_member
assertions: 18 native XLSX/XLSM/XLTX/XLTM packages including Strict: exact sheet names/order/kinds/flavors, ordinary-cell reads, typed nonworksheet refusal and all no-op member payloads.
tests.scope_limit: Catalog/container baseline; no whole-feature claim for each embedded part.

tests.name: native_excel_array_shared_dynamic_and_what_if_formula_owners_keep_stored_caches
assertions: CSE range/cache; all 100 ROW()*2 copied/shared formulas; SEQUENCE/FILTER/LET stored expressions, spill values and ownership; two what-if data-table ranges/caches. Formula caches report Stored/Unknown.
tests.scope_limit: No formula evaluation, dependency proof, scenario application or data-table calculation.

tests.name: native_excel_agile_password_ingress_and_rekey_keep_clear_members
assertions: Empty/wrong/correct passwords, native AgileAes256Sha512 profile, marker and 42/84 value/cache, implicit plaintext refusal, rekey with old-key rejection and all clear member payloads retained.
tests.scope_limit: In-memory decryption/rekey of one profile; no fresh Excel reopen.

tests.name: native_excel_cell_create_update_remove_preserves_other_parts_and_inverts
assertions: Scalar CRUD on 17 native variants; ProtectedSheet refusal on the protected eighteenth fixture. Chain removal and recalculation flags are explicit related changes; other payloads and workbook fields stay intact. Retained-owner inverses are byte exact, reopened inverses preserve all relationship fields and exact content-type/other member bytes.
tests.scope_limit: No worksheet restructuring or formula computation. Reopened workbook-relationship ordering may canonicalize; pass-through assets are not all typed.

tests.name: native_excel_validation_notes_names_and_print_settings_are_typed
assertions: Seven validation kinds/ranges/formula bounds and revision IDs; exact two classic note texts including author prefix and CRLF; three defined names; landscape, scale/first page, stored zero DPI, margins and cached totals.
tests.scope_limit: Stored validation and print metadata only; no input execution, pagination or printer interaction.

tests.name: native_excel_1904_dates_breaks_and_hidden_rows_keep_stored_values
assertions: 1904 date system, exact numeric lexical serials and formula caches including negative/time values, hidden rows/column and exact horizontal/vertical manual-break bounds.
tests.scope_limit: No date-format rendering, formula evaluation or pagination.

tests.name: native_excel_cryptoapi_password_contract_retains_profile_ciphertext_and_cells
assertions: Absent/wrong/correct passwords, native CryptoAPI RC4 128-bit profile, exact Sheet1 marker and 42/84 cells, implicit-publication refusal and exact retained ciphertext reopen.
tests.scope_limit: No plaintext serialization, rekeying or encrypted-source editing; cached formula result only.

tests.name: native_excel_encrypted_xlsb_has_an_explicit_unsupported_container_boundary
assertions: Native encrypted CFB is rejected as UnsupportedFeature on byte, reader, path, eager workbook and lazy sequential/positional entry points; input-byte limits keep precedence.
tests.scope_limit: XLSB package decryption is unimplemented. Container-signature diagnostic only; no password testing or cryptographic validation claimed.

tests.name: native_excel_formula_queries_and_atomic_scalar_edits_work_on_both_owners
assertions: Both Auto/Eager routes query cached value 206 at D103, read formula ROW()*2, atomically create numeric and formula-looking inert string cells, reopen and exactly invert while preserving the original source.
tests.scope_limit: Ordinary scalar edits and stored-cache query only; no formula execution.

tests.name: native_excel_slicer_cache_and_view_graph_keep_names_bindings_and_selections
assertions: Two native slicer caches with exact names, source fields, revision GUIDs and pivot-table bindings; tabular data discriminator and retained raw selection indices/flags; two worksheet views with captions, heights and column counts.
tests.scope_limit: Selection items remain inert retained XML; no UI or filtering is applied.

tests.name: native_excel_timeline_cache_and_view_keep_selected_month_window
assertions: Native 2011 timeline graph, exact cache/source/GUID, table binding and internal cache ID, February 2026 selection/year bounds and month-level view.
tests.scope_limit: Stored ranges and control metadata only; no refresh, UI rendering or live filtering.

tests.name: native_excel_pivots_and_structured_tables_retain_records_axes_and_cached_totals
assertions: Across XLSX, XLTX, Strict XLSX and pivot-controls: Table1 range/columns/filter bounds, native direct sort-state/key spans, all eight decoded cache rows, field roles and Sum aggregation metadata, and exact stored filtered/unfiltered totals.
tests.scope_limit: Reads cached source data; no pivot calculation, table-filter execution or arbitrary PivotTable authoring.

tests.name: native_excel_sparkline_groups_keep_series_destinations_flags_and_colors
assertions: Across four native variants: line/column groups, all four formulas/destinations, hidden-data/high/low flags, series color and exact revision GUIDs. Native models serialize and reparse without losing identity.
tests.scope_limit: Metadata/fragment round trip only; no sparkline calculation or rendering.

tests.name: native_excel_slicer_and_timeline_caption_edits_preserve_other_parts_and_invert
assertions: Native caption edits preserve every unrelated OPC member, retain complete readback models and invert after reopen; filter-application methods give explicit Unsupported errors.
tests.scope_limit: Caption changes only, with metadata/UI boundaries kept separate; no native Excel reopen.

tests.name: native_excel_conditional_rules_keep_priority_thresholds_and_extension_association
assertions: Eight core rules plus the Office 2010 data-bar enhancement: exact ranges/priorities/kinds, source-order priorities, DXF references/formulas, color scale and icon thresholds, colors, GUID association and solid/automatic extension flags.
tests.scope_limit: Stored conditional-format declarations only; no condition evaluation or rendering.

tests.name: native_excel_slicer_cache_order_edits_find_mixed_case_owner_and_invert
assertions: Cache reordering finds the native mixed-case extension GUID, changes the workbook integration order, preserves other members and inverts exactly after reopen.
tests.scope_limit: Two existing cache references only; not a general refresh or pivot calculation claim.

tests.name: native_slicer_caches_keep_identity_bindings_and_selected_items
assertions: Two native caches: exact names, fields, internal cache ID, PivotTable bindings, sort/cross-filter flags and selected-item indices. Native identity blocks and complete cache bytes round-trip exactly.
tests.scope_limit: Inert cache metadata; no filter application, rendering or refresh.

tests.name: native_slicer_caption_edit_preserves_caches_identities_and_other_members
assertions: Caption edit and typed readback on the worksheet after a chart tab; every unrelated member and retained view/cache identity is preserved; inverse after reopen restores all member bytes.
tests.scope_limit: One view caption operation, not active slicer filtering.

tests.name: native_pivot_cache_records_tables_and_view_bindings_keep_saved_values
assertions: All eight decoded PivotCache source rows, including direct/shared date encodings, six field identities, cache/view bindings, source table captions/range/header and stored 175.5/9.5 totals.
tests.scope_limit: Pivot view identity/binding and stored data only; no full view-layout or aggregation execution claim.

tests.name: native_notes_read_and_edit_keep_other_note_vml_and_package_payloads
assertions: Two exact note texts/authors/runs on eager and source owners; text replacement resets only the changed note to the default font, preserving the other note, VML and every unrelated member; exact inverse.
tests.scope_limit: Classic notes; no threaded-comment or Office display claim.

tests.name: native_1904_layout_and_page_break_edit_preserve_serials_and_other_parts
assertions: 1904 date flag and six exact stored serials, hidden rows/column and widths; exact row/column breaks, add/readback/inverse and all unrelated worksheet records and parts preserved.
tests.scope_limit: Print coverage is page-break metadata only. Worksheet page setup, margins and header/footer lack typed readers; chart-sheet print support is separate.

tests.name: native_array_shared_and_dynamic_groups_keep_ranges_tokens_and_all_caches
assertions: Five exact grouped ranges and wire payload round-trips; CSE text/range and four caches, all 100 copied/shared formulas, eleven dynamic/LET caches with explicit opaque Unsupported status and retained group token/ancillary data, twenty what-if outputs.
tests.scope_limit: Dynamic expressions remain opaque rather than evaluated/rendered. What-if results are stored scalars; data-table execution is not implemented.

tests.name: native_scenarios_retain_inputs_and_metadata_edits_do_not_apply_them
assertions: Two named scenarios with exact comments/input cells/values and locked/hidden/current/shown state; reversible comment edit preserves all non-scenario records, other parts and the original input/model cell values.
tests.scope_limit: Scenario metadata edits do not apply scenarios or recalculate cells.

tests.name: native_slicer_cache_identity_refuses_malformed_envelopes_and_limits
assertions: Derived native cache streams reject inconsistent product counts, short or duplicate UIDs, missing/nonempty ends, wrong record kinds and repeated blocks; writer and raw payload limits also refuse.
tests.scope_limit: Malformed derivatives are created only in memory; native bytes are immutable.

tests.name: native_slicer_cache_metadata_edit_keeps_parts_relationships_and_inverse
assertions: Native sort-order metadata update preserves cache part names, relationship IDs, UIDs and every unrelated part; typed readback and inverse are exact.
tests.scope_limit: Sort metadata is stored only; no PivotCache computation or UI application.

tests.name: native_slicer_cache_reorder_and_add_remove_handle_sparse_relationship_ids
assertions: Cache reordering changes only workbook integration bytes; add/remove handles occupied numeric relationship IDs without looping, and typed cache collections and inverse bytes are exact.
tests.scope_limit: New cache is inert and receives no copied native UID; no refresh or filter behavior claim.

tests.name: native_binary_index_binds_metadata_prefix_to_actual_formula_cell_only
assertions: The native 358-byte metadata anchor resolves to the actual 364-byte A4 formula; indexed cache reads return exact values. Interior, preceding, later-cell and foreign-record offsets are rejected.
tests.scope_limit: Only validated contiguous CellMeta/ValueMeta prefixes are recognized; arbitrary offsets and stale indexes are not accepted.

tests.name: native_xlsb_formula_queries_and_scalar_crud_keep_stored_caches_on_both_owners
assertions: Auto/Eager routes query D103=206 and formula text, create/update/remove cells on both sheets, retain stored formula caches and inert formula-looking text, and invert to exact source bytes.
tests.scope_limit: Public query/scalar CRUD only; no evaluation, dynamic formula compilation or native Excel reopen.
